verdict.rationale: Xero ships JAX, an in-product AI feature that gives 'instant answers about your cash flow, profit trends and financial health,' auto-categorizes/reconciles transactions, and drafts invoices/bills from AI-extracted data—directly matching the story of AI-generated insights/suggestions from user data inside the product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reviews validating JAX's insight quality, and more detail on the scope/accuracy of the 'instant answers' feature beyond marketing copy.
